summary: Iteration 3 validated the new 'Photos in Reviews' feature end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 new tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_photos.py — POST /api/uploads accepts PNG for authed demo user & returns {id}, rejects unauth (401), pdf/text (400), >8MB (400); GET /api/files/{id} returns image bytes publicly with image/* content-type and 404 for unknown; POST /api/cafes/{id}/reviews accepts photos list, rejects photos not owned by the user (400) and >4 photos (422 from Pydantic max_length), editing a review (same user re-posts) updates the photos list. Frontend: logged in as demo, /cafe/<id>?review=1 auto-opens review-form-dialog showing review-photo-picker; uploading 2 PNGs via review-photo-input produces 2 review-photo-preview-<id> tiles, remove via review-photo-remove-<id> works, adding 3 more hits max=4 and review-photo-add tile hides; submit yields photo-thumb-<fileId> thumbnails that open photo-lightbox; cafe Overview shows community-photos; edit-review preloads 4 previews; reviews dashboard shows feed-photos-<reviewId>. /scan page still loads (regression ok). Existing iteration-2 test suite still green.

minor.issue: No image-content sniffing — a non-image payload sent with Content-Type: image/png would be accepted (relies on client header). Low risk because frontend uses accept='image/*', but server-side magic-byte check (e.g. imghdr) would be more defensive.
No per-user/per-cafe rate limit on uploads; a logged-in user can upload unlimited files which all live in object storage. Consider daily cap or orphan cleanup.
Photos attached to a prior review that is replaced are not pruned from db.files/object-storage — orphaned files remain accessible via /api/files/{id}. Non-blocking but worth a cleanup job.
No ETag / 304 support; only Cache-Control header. Not critical.

issues: feed-photos-<id> renders a <PhotoStrip> whose thumb buttons are nested inside the outer <Link to=/cafe/...>. e.stopPropagation() handles the navigation, but HTML spec disallows button-inside-anchor nesting; some browsers may still bubble on keyboard activation. Consider replacing the outer Link with a programmatic onClick or moving the strip outside the anchor.
Loading spinners for in-flight uploads don't carry a data-testid; adding one (e.g. review-photo-uploading) would help future tests detect in-flight state.

action_items: (optional hardening) Add magic-byte image validation on /api/uploads instead of trusting Content-Type.
(optional hygiene) When replacing a review, soft-delete photo file records that are no longer referenced.
(carry-over from iter 2) Remove last two 'Bean' string references in AISummary.js and Explore.js (unchanged this iteration).
(carry-over from iter 1) Tighten CORS_ORIGINS to the explicit public origin.
critical_code_review_comments: ReviewIn.photos uses max_length=4 which Pydantic enforces with 422; backend 'owned' check uses len(set(photos)) so duplicate ids would be silently de-duplicated instead of 400 — minor edge case worth noting.
PhotoStrip buttons are nested inside <Link> on ReviewsDashboard — invalid HTML (button inside anchor). Works today thanks to stopPropagation but should be refactored.
No orphan file cleanup: uploaded fileIds that are never attached to a review (user cancels) remain in object storage and db.files forever.
server.py now ~535 lines — still single-module monolith; splitting (auth, cafes, reviews, uploads, admin, ai) would improve maintainability.
storage.put_object does synchronous requests; routed through asyncio.to_thread which is fine, but a shared aiohttp client would avoid per-request connection setup.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 new photo tests, iter-2 suite 20/20 still green)

seed_data_creation: Test review on first cafe (demo user) created and deleted at end of class via test_cleanup_review. Several TEST_ uploads remain in object storage/db.files — see action_items for orphan cleanup suggestion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Photos-in-Reviews feature works end-to-end. Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_photos.py cover auth, mime filter, size cap, public GET, ownership check, max=4, edit-update. Frontend testids: review-photo-picker, review-photo-input, review-photo-preview-<id>, review-photo-remove-<id>, review-photo-add, photo-thumb-<fileId>, photo-lightbox, review-photos-<reviewId>, community-photos, feed-photos-<reviewId>. Note the Overview tab is default after cafe navigation — review-photos-<id> only renders inside the Reviews tab. Edit-review uses `initial.photos` and preloads them correctly.
rca of the issue: No bug found; feature is correctly implemented. Only hygiene/defensive-coding suggestions noted.
